_help: Partner shops in AR Hunt. Copy the example, fill it in and set active to true. lat/lon: right-click the shop in Google Maps to copy them. radius is how far away (in metres) players see a beacon pointing to the shop; catchRadius is how close they must be for the sign to stand at the shop and be caught (40 m allows for GPS error). brandColor is a hex colour. glb is optional: put the shop's own 3D model in the partners/ folder and give its path, otherwise a branded sign is shown. validUntil (YYYY-MM-DD) ends the campaign automatically.
